baseline_18_pieces.piece_text: Start learning data skills this month. Data Foundations gives learners weekly live sessions, recordings and a community forum. Join by 30 November 2026. [Link: Explore Data Foundations]

Learners cut their study time by 50%. Start your free trial today.

Learn at your own pace on any device. [Image: smiling learner at laptop | Alt text: none]
